cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front; a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a small late-night neighbourhood cinema foyer beside a softly glowing abstract film poster — waiting through the end credits outside the auditorium; a lit dance stage or milonga floor — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sheltered tidal lagoon with a wooden bathing ladder and floating amber lamps at dusk — sitting at the dry ladder landing after a dip; a starship data archive — sitting on the ground; a running track with lane lines and a grandstand — dries her hair with a towel; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — holds a wooden practice sword point-down at her side; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — standing; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing with one foot up on a step; a night observatory under an open dome — holds a book closed against her chest
